features.name: physchem_center_scaled_distance
features.description: Root-mean-square z distance from the training-fold center for pH, conductivity, dissolved oxygen, flow, and turbidity, clipped for stable neighbor search.
features.expected_model_benefit: Balances water chemistry and hydraulic state on a single normalized axis so KNN neighborhoods are not dominated by raw units.

features.name: thermal_season_scaled_distance
features.description: Root-mean-square z distance from the training-fold center for week of year, air temperature, water temperature, and recent average temperatures.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups rows with similar seasonal timing and thermal regime even when individual temperature columns have different scales.

features.name: recent_weather_scaled_distance
features.description: Log-scaled recent rainfall and solar anomaly distance using 1-day, 3-day, 5-day, and 10-day weather summaries.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places rainfall and sunlight histories on comparable scales, improving local geometry for short-term weather effects.

features.name: warm_wet_runoff_prototype_distance
features.description: Distance to an unsupervised warm, wet, turbid runoff prototype built from training-fold means and spreads.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives KNN a smooth distance to a common runoff-like state rather than relying on several correlated raw columns.

features.name: clear_baseflow_prototype_distance
features.description: Distance to an unsupervised clear, low-flow, sunny baseflow prototype using hydrology, turbidity, recent precipitation, solar exposure, and dissolved oxygen.
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates clear baseflow-like rows from high-runoff rows with a compact distance useful for nearest-neighbor ranking.

features.name: warm_flush_cluster_flag
features.description: Binary indicator for rows at or above training-fold means for water temperature, flow, turbidity, and 10-day precipitation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a discrete neighborhood anchor for warm flush conditions, helping KNN respect a nonlinear regime boundary.

features.name: animal_source_pressure_similarity
features.description: Clipped 0-1 similarity to a livestock pressure setting using presence and density indicators for general livestock, cattle, horses, and poultry.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses several animal-source indicators into one scale-aligned axis for neighborhoods with similar agricultural pressure.
features.formula: np.clip((0.25 * anylivestock_pa) + (0.20 * np.log1p(anylivestock_density) / np.log1p(3.04)) + (0.20 * cattle_pa) + (0.15 * np.log1p(cattle_density) / np.log1p(2.9)) + (0.10 * livestock_horse_pa) + (0.10 * livestock_poultry_pa), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: developed_waste_pressure_similarity
features.description: Clipped 0-1 similarity to a developed wastewater and settlement pressure setting using wastewater, septic, trailer, camp, and stormwater indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aligns rows with similar wastewater, septic, trailer, camp, and settlement pressure while reducing unit imbalance.
features.formula: np.clip((0.25 * wastewater_pa) + (0.15 * np.log1p(wastewater_density) / np.log1p(0.231)) + (0.20 * ((septic_adj_sepden_m2 - 59.5) / (251.0 - 59.5))) + (0.15 * trailer_pa) + (0.10 * camp_pa) + (0.15 * stormwateroutfalls_pa), 0.0, 1.0)

features.name: road_outfall_connectivity_similarity
features.description: Clipped 0-1 similarity to direct road, ditch, and stormwater connectivity using proximity and presence fields.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights rows where overland or pipe-linked transport may be short, improving distance structure for connectivity.

features.name: natural_retention_context_similarity
features.description: Clipped 0-1 similarity to a vegetated or wetland-buffered context using aquatic vegetation, forest or wetland cover, waterbody presence, organic matter, and clay.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a natural-buffer context axis so rows with similar retention or dilution setting can be close in distance space.

features.name: hydrologic_event_semantic_score
features.description: Analyst-assigned ordinal score from 0 to 4 summarizing whether the row resembles dry stable conditions, rainfall recovery, or active runoff using only precipitation, flow, turbidity, solar, and temperature fields.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a compact human-reviewed hydro-meteorological state axis when formulas underrepresent mixed event timing.

features.name: source_overlap_semantic_score
features.description: Analyst-assigned ordinal score from 0 to 4 capturing how many independent source pathways appear plausible in the row, considering livestock, wastewater, septic, trailers, camps, roads, outfalls, and nearby waterbody context.
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups rows with similar multi-pathway pressure narratives when individual binary and distance fields disagree.
